name: London City Race 2026
scope: Post-hoc manual correspondence audit of five named road junctions on the original image and the same OSM snapshot. The saved automatic registration was produced before these points were chosen and was not refitted. Approximate predicted positions helped locate the candidate junctions; final pixels were read from unoverlaid source crops. This is not a blinded benchmark and is not field GPS validation. The auto fit used water/building outlines, not these road junction pairs.

omittedBeforeMeasurement.reason: Road edges are partly hidden by purple overprint; the source point is ambiguous.

originalBenchmarkRetained: new-place-holdout-slow.json still reports its unmodified error against the supplied world file; this case is not counted as an independent world-file accuracy success.
